page.overview:
What is Dino Attack?

Dino Attack is a theme released in North America, Japan, and Australia in 2005. It was alternatively released as Dino 2010 in Europe, with both variants collectively known as Dino on LEGO.com.

Dino Attack is the third LEGO System theme primarily focused on dinosaurs, following and Dinosaurs. It includes five sets, and each set includes futuristic military vehicles fighting against dinosaurs. The vehicles are primarily brick yellow and dark red and are armed with various weapons, including functional projectile launchers. The dinosaurs are new unique molds representing giant mutant dinosaurs, with the three largest dinosaurs (Raptor, Pteranodon, and T-Rex) sharing certain molds. The theme features four minifigure characters (Shadow, Digger, Specs, and Viper) wearing five different uniforms, with each set featuring a unique combination.

All sets were released in summer 2005. Some additional merchandise and gear were released in 2006; these are identical between Dino Attack and Dino 2010, with the only differences being theme branding and product numbers.

The story of Dino Attack is primarily shown in the online stories, character profiles, and LEGO Magazine articles and comics. The theme also has an online Dino Attack Game developed by Yamago. A promotional Japanese poster "恐竜＆ダイノバスターズ図鑑" features a story description and character profiles, and most significantly reveals that the dinosaurs escaped a museum after they were mutated by radioactive contamination from a science laboratory.
